configuration.constraint_cost: Unique deadline-eligible misses becoming due in this control interval divided by unique eligible packets becoming due, zero when none. Mean across three slices.
configuration.reliability: Lossless service; achieved reliability is timely-delivered fraction of deadline-eligible packets. Workbook Reliability is target only.
configuration.fault_semantics: Recorded fault flag is a plan input. Explicit fault_windows separately reduce available PRBs; this is an ideal service fault, not detection validation.

preprocessing.split: Original row order within each slice; first 12,000 for training and last 3,000 held out.
preprocessing.workload_timing: 10 ms demand-holding intervals and 1 ms service ticks; original workbook has no timestamps and its Control_Interval field is not replayed as physical time.
preprocessing.numeric_imputation: Per-slice training median only; finite positive requested rates/deadlines required.
preprocessing.committed_rate_rule: eMBB: 0.9 x median requested DL (the SLA proxy floor); uRLLC and mMTC: 95th percentile of the requested DL; the remainder of a request is best effort and is not offered to the slice queue.
